answer: Re-attestations are stored in tundra and voyage lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the inlet graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 3135 identities would post 4367 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
